steps.cmd:
cat > /app/output/reach.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np,json
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
s=json.load(open('/app/output/spec.json'));a=np.load('/app/output/robot_model.npz');qh=a['qh'];T0=a['T0'];axes=a['axes'];W=axes[:,:3,:3];W2=W@W;v=axes[:,:3,3]
lo=np.array([s['action_types']['joint_position']['limits'][f'panda_joint{i}'][0] for i in range(1,8)])
hi=np.array([s['action_types']['joint_position']['limits'][f'panda_joint{i}'][1] for i in range(1,8)])
def fk(q):
 t=q-qh
 Rs=np.eye(3)+np.sin(t)[:,None,None]*W+(1-np.cos(t))[:,None,None]*W2
 ps=np.einsum('ijk,ik->ij',t[:,None,None]*np.eye(3)+(1-np.cos(t))[:,None,None]*W+(t-np.sin(t))[:,None,None]*W2,v)
 R=np.eye(3);p=np.zeros(3)
 for j in range(7):p+=R@ps[j];R=R@Rs[j]
 return p+R@T0[:3,3],R@T0[:3,:3]
pts=np.load('/app/output/bincloud.npy');rng=np.random.default_rng(21)
results=[]
for target in [[.23,-.5566,-.5422],[.14,-.6,-.54],[.1,-.6,-.54]]:
 best=None
 for i in range(20):
  start=qh if i==0 else rng.uniform(lo,hi)
  sol=least_squares(lambda q:fk(q)[0]-target,start,bounds=(lo,hi),max_nfev=200,ftol=1e-9,xtol=1e-9,gtol=1e-9)
  err=np.linalg.norm(sol.fun)
  if best is None or err<best[0]:best=(err,sol.x,fk(sol.x))
 print('target',target,'err',best[0],'q',best[1],'pose',best[2][0],Rotation.from_matrix(best[2][1]).as_quat(scalar_first=True),flush=True)
 results.append({'target':target,'err':best[0],'q':best[1].tolist(),'pos':best[2][0].tolist(),'quat':Rotation.from_matrix(best[2][1]).as_quat(scalar_first=True).tolist()})
json.dump(results,open('/app/output/reach_results.json','w'),indent=2)
PY
